snippet.title: Sonic Quickshot SAGE 2025 Trailer
snippet.description:
Sonic Quickshot is a 2D classic Sonic game, developed in Game Maker using the Orbinaut Framework 2 from SAGE 2024. This demo features 20 levels from 2 zones as themes: Sky Station and Technology Tree, a zone from Sonic: After the Sequel! Play as Sonic, Tails, Knuckles, or Amy, master the challenges, and gather all the red rings.

Check out the game, it's available to download now at https://sonicfangameshq.com/forums/showcase/sonic-quickshot-sage-25-demo.2679/
